public_rationale: Broadcom's December call supports a narrower concern: the 10GW announcement was an alignment with little expected contribution in 2026. The same call described ongoing custom-chip development and anticipated a committed element. That distinction prevents a clean finding that the deployment deal was either proceeding concretely or not happening. Missing publicly disclosed orders are not themselves proof of inactivity.
limitations: The wording does not define what counts as happening.
The transcript is a third-party reproduction of company statements.
Later implementation would not by itself establish the arrangement's December 2025 status.

our_interpretation: Assess the 10GW deployment arrangement identified in the surrounding passage, excluding the stock-price explanation.
Preserve the tentative wording: assess whether available records showed the deployment arrangement becoming a concrete commercial undertaking.
Use December 1–29, 2025 as the latest month-to-publication status period.

Distinguish the 10GW deployment commitment from the separate custom-chip development program.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporaneous records establish that the 10GW arrangement remained uncommitted and was not progressing into orders or implementation, or had been suspended or abandoned.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Contemporaneous records establish binding deployment orders or concrete implementation of the 10GW arrangement.
